name: @tamaclaude/root
description: A tiny desk display for your Claude Code sessions
author: Alex Clapperton

scripts.measure: rm -rf out/measure && for f in assets/clawd/animations/*.svg; do a=$(basename "$f" .svg); node tools/svg2frames.ts "$f" "out/measure/$a" >/dev/null; done && node tools/measure-compression.ts out/measure/*
scripts.harness: for a in typing thinking gym bouldering; do node tools/svg2frames.ts "assets/clawd/animations/$a.svg" "out/$a" >/dev/null; done && node tools/harness.ts out/typing out/thinking out/gym out/bouldering
scripts.throughput:sweep: for c in 256 1024 4096 16384 65536; do echo "$c B: $(node tools/usb-throughput.ts /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 6 "$c" | grep 'device saw' | sed 's/.*-> //')"; done
